title: Blue light-activated 5,10,15,20-tetrakis(4-bromophenyl)porphyrin for photodynamic eradication of drug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39779-39786
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07666D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hongshuang Qin, Huaying Niu, Yanxiang Guo, Xiaoting Wang, Tao Liu, Chuanqi Zhao
Photodynamic therapy mediated by 5,10,15,20-tetrakis(4-bromophenyl)porphyrin (TBPP) effectively eliminates drug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus, inhibits biofilm formation and accelerates wound healing in a mouse model.
